decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions the proposal would not result in harm to the appearance of the property or the wider area and would not cause harm to neighbours' living conditions in accordance with adopted policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development), and E.5.1 (Visitor Accommodation), of the Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

(Reason.  To accord with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990)

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

(Reason.  To ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission)

Condition : 4 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

(Reason.  In order to safeguard the visual amenity of the area and building)
description: Erection of a single storey conservatory to rear of hotel and replacement canopy to front entrance.
